name: Concepción (Antioquia, Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, red and yellow, the red charged with a white scroll bearing the motto PASO DE VENCEDORES in yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Concepción, a municipality in the department of Antioquia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: scroll with the motto PASO DE VENCEDORES
